text:
Stretched lobed getting red and swollen after 12 years ?
Hi,
I've had my lobe stretched for 12 years (not much, just 8mm). It's been healed for a long long time without any issue, i clean it with soap and water everyday, no issue.
I got my helix (same ear) pierced 6 months ago. Helix's healing was going fine, until 2 weeks ago it started getting a tiny bit infected, i took care of it and now it's back to healing fine, no sign of infection.
However my stretched lobe started getting "wet" (no pus, just clear watery like substance) and hurting and itching. I didn't think much of it but it kept going for a couple of days, to the point i decided to take it out and let it air out. I can't put the plug back in now (too much pain) and it is red and swollen.
What should I do ? I don't have smaller plugs so i can't put a 6mm back in for now, and no shops nearby to get one. How urgent is it to get something back in to prevent it from closing ? Has this ever happened to anyone after such a long time ?
I was wearing black surgical steel, same thing i had been wearing for years, so i don't get where this is coming from.
Thank you for your help !
